mapper.select: /*getMasterMpRqBuyerRemarkList*/ SELECT RE_NOTE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'CLRM' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS CLRM_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'MOQT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS MOQT_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'DSRM' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS DSRM_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ASRM' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS ASRM_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ASRMGD' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS ASRMGD_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'QSRM' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS QSRM_REMARK FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')

mapper.update: /*insertMasterMpRqBuyerRemarkOne*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD2 ( TYPE, CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TEXT1, FLAG, ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{TYPE}, #{st_buyer_code}, 'KRKORE0001', #{REMARK}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )
